scope: Original synthetic data only; no personal conversations, queries, embeddings or private evaluation results.
feature: Constraint-preserving explicit Event graph continuation through existing read/sources MCP tools.
covered_contracts: Original anchor keeps graph steps monotonic; previous then sibling is rejected.
Role/time/current-path/as_of boundaries are applied before output and at every intermediate node.
Filtered fork cannot become an apparently unique branch.
Source platform/account/conversation/scope, suppression and current revisions remain boundaries.
Duplicate provider-node identities produce stops, not advertised unusable endpoints.
Constrained cursor binds original anchor, filters, as_of, detail, current graph, access and byte budget.
Exact UTF-8 text reassembly; constrained full reads are marked projections rather than raw records.
Real stdio MCP walks an artificial 12-message chain beyond the fixed 3-hop search window.
Search continuation candidates and read schema explicitly distinguish graph steps from text pagination.
limitations: Tool budgets measure result JSON UTF-8 bytes, not tokenizer or billing tokens.
Multi-call clients must enforce a cumulative budget; per-call caps do not cap a workflow.
Ranking and query-vector availability are unchanged.
Constrained filter/anchor options are MCP additions; legacy CLI read arguments are unchanged.
No claim of complete conversations, model answer quality, desktop IPC validation or general semantic accuracy.
